tools.name: orders_catalog_search
tools.title: Search the grocery catalog
tools.description: Use when the person asks what is available or what something costs.

query.description: What to look for, such as oat milk.

tools.name: mandate_status
tools.title: What the assistant may do
tools.description: Use when the person asks what the assistant is allowed to buy, how much is left, or until when.

tools.name: mandate_propose
tools.title: Ask for permission to reorder
tools.description: Use when the person says what the assistant may buy, how much, and for how long, such as "you can reorder groceries up to fifty dollars today". The person confirms before it takes effect.

totalLimitUsd.description: The most the assistant may spend in total, in dollars.

perCallLimitUsd.description: The most for a single item, in dollars.

resourceIds.description: Which items; groceries if not given.

items.description: The item, such as milk, eggs, bread, fruit or oat milk.

durationSeconds.description: How long the permission lasts, in seconds; until the end of today if not given.

tools.name: mandate_revoke
tools.title: Take back the permission
tools.description: Use when the person says the assistant should stop buying things.

tools.name: orders_stage_cart
tools.title: Add to the cart
tools.description: Use when the person asks to add an item to the grocery order, by count ("two cartons of milk") or by amount ("fifteen dollars of fruit"). Nothing is ordered yet.

amountUsd.description: How much, in dollars, for items sold by amount.

mandateVersion.description: The permission version the caller read, if it knows one.

tools.name: orders_review_cart
tools.title: Read the cart
tools.description: Use when the person asks what is in the cart or what it costs.

tools.name: orders_request_checkout
tools.title: Ask to place the order
tools.description: Use when the person asks to place or send the order. The person is asked to confirm items and total; only their yes places it.

tools.name: orders_confirm
tools.title: Confirm by voice
tools.description: Use only after the person answered yes to a question the assistant asked out loud, passing the token that question came with.

token.description: The token from the question the person said yes to.
